annotations.title: TIA — download to the PLC (GATE G3)

description: Downloads hardware/software to the PHYSICAL CPU (STOPS and RESTARTS the CPU). GATE G3: does NOT download without human approval. dryRun:true asks serve for a VERIFIED plan (clean compile, PG/PC interface found, software fingerprint) and returns a single-use planHash that expires (TIA_PLAN_TTL_MS, default 15 min). After a human approves that plan, call with approved:true and the SAME planHash; serve re-checks the fingerprint inside the download and refuses (plan_stale) if the project changed. Pick connectionMode/pcInterfaceName/targetInterfaceName with tia_pg_interfaces (no scan). The serve also issues its own single-use approval token with the plan; this MCP keeps it and sends it with the download (a newer serve refuses any download without it — keep this MCP up to date). Requires app ≥ v1.6.0. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/download/plan and POST /plcs/{plc}/download. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

allowUpgradeTargetDevice.description: confirm TIA's 'upgrade the target device' check (default false). Part of the approved plan — changing it needs a new dryRun + approval

approved.description: G3: only true after explicit HUMAN APPROVAL

dryRun.description: Gd11: returns the plan + planHash WITHOUT downloading

planHash.description: G3: the single-use approval token returned by dryRun (issued only by this MCP process; expires)
